data.name: AlJabbaroon
data.gender_notes: AlJabbaroon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root j-b-r, which means to compel, AlJabbaroon is a name of Allah, signifying His irresistible power and might. The name AlJabbaroon carries the meaning “The Compeller, The Irresistible” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlJabbaroon usually hope their child will grow to embody the compeller, the irresistible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: AlJabbaroon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Compeller, The Irresistible.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlJabbaroon total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: AlJabbaroon
in_english.meaning: The greatest amount, the most powerful, the ruler over all, the one who holds the highest opinion
in_english.long_meaning: The name AlJabbaroon is derived from the Arabic root "J-B-R", which means the greatest amount, the most powerful, the ruler over all, the one who holds the highest opinion. This name is used to describe Allah's power and authority as the Lord of the universe. In Islamic tradition, this name is considered one of the most majestic and awe-inspiring names of Allah. It is often used in conjunction with other names such as Al-Aziz (The Mighty) and Al-Rahman (The Most Merciful).
